products.name: Dell PowerEdge R750
products.description: High-performance 2U rack server with 3rd-generation Intel Xeon processors, up to 3TB of RAM, and support for mission-critical workloads including databases, virtualization, and analytics.
products.roi_pitch: Reduces total cost of ownership (TCO) by up to 30% by consolidating multiple legacy servers onto a single high-performance platform.
products.pain_solved: Eliminates dependency on obsolete infrastructure that drives high maintenance costs, unplanned downtime, and operational bottlenecks.

products.name: Dell PowerStore 500
products.description: AI-powered intelligent all-flash storage system with automated performance optimization. Supports NVMe, scales non-disruptively, and integrates seamlessly with multicloud and hybrid environments.
products.roi_pitch: Delivers up to 4x better performance versus traditional storage with up to 67% reduction in physical footprint and energy consumption, achieving positive ROI in under 12 months.
products.pain_solved: Resolves capacity shortfalls, slow data access, and the rising maintenance costs of aging storage systems.

products.name: Dell APEX Cloud Services
products.description: Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS) platform enabling on-demand consumption of compute, storage, and networking resources under a pay-as-you-go model. Compatible with AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud for multicloud strategies.
products.roi_pitch: As-a-service model that eliminates capital expenditure (CAPEX) and converts infrastructure into predictable operating expense (OPEX), with immediate scalability and zero over-provisioning.
products.pain_solved: Eliminates the rigidity of fixed infrastructure that prevents rapid scaling in response to demand spikes or new digital initiatives.

products.name: Dell PowerSwitch N-Series
products.description: Enterprise network switch family supporting 1GbE, 10GbE, and 25GbE. Open networking design with SmartFabric OS for automation, ideal for modern data centers and campus environments.
products.roi_pitch: Reduces network configuration time by up to 90% through SmartFabric automation, minimizing human error and freeing IT teams to focus on strategic initiatives.
products.pain_solved: Resolves slow, complex-to-manage networks with high reliance on manual configuration that introduce security risks and slow incident response times.

products.name: Dell Latitude 5540
products.description: 15.6-inch enterprise laptop with 13th-generation Intel Core processors, MIL-SPEC durability certifications, 5G/LTE connectivity options, and integrated remote management via Dell ProManage.
products.roi_pitch: Centrally managed endpoint fleet via Dell ProManage, reducing IT support costs by up to 25% and extending device lifecycle.
products.pain_solved: Replaces aging devices responsible for high support incident rates, reduced remote work productivity, and security risks from unsupported operating systems.

products.name: Dell PowerProtect Data Manager
products.description: Modern data protection platform with automated backup, disaster recovery (DR), and ransomware protection. Compatible with virtual environments (VMware, Hyper-V), Kubernetes, and multicloud.
products.roi_pitch: Reduces recovery time objective (RTO) up to 4x versus traditional solutions, protecting business continuity and avoiding downtime losses that average $5,600 USD per minute in enterprise environments.
products.pain_solved: Eliminates vulnerability to ransomware attacks and critical data loss while ensuring compliance with data protection regulations including GDPR, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS.

products.name: Corporate VPN SecOps Guard
products.description: Enterprise perimeter security solution with industrial-grade VPN, 24/7 SOC monitoring, intrusion detection (IDS/IPS), and network segmentation for critical OT/IT environments. Designed for industrial infrastructure, refineries, and manufacturing plants with SCADA and legacy systems.
products.roi_pitch: Reduces cybersecurity incident risk at industrial facilities by up to 80%, preventing losses that average $4.7M USD per attack in the energy sector.
products.pain_solved: Protects critical OT/IT infrastructure at refineries and manufacturing plants against ransomware attacks, unauthorized access, and vulnerabilities in legacy SCADA systems.

products.name: Dell PowerEdge R760 for AI Workloads
products.description: 2U rack server optimized for AI, machine learning, and high-performance analytics workloads. Supports NVIDIA A100/H100 GPUs, high-speed NVMe, and InfiniBand connectivity for distributed compute clusters.
products.roi_pitch: Accelerates time-to-insight up to 5x versus standard servers, reducing AI infrastructure costs compared to equivalent public cloud solutions.
products.pain_solved: Eliminates dependency on public cloud for sensitive AI workloads, keeping critical data on-premise with superior performance and predictable cost.

products.name: Dell APEX Data Storage Services
products.description: Enterprise Storage-as-a-Service (STaaS) with a flexible consumption model, automatic scalability, and unified management for multicloud and hybrid environments. Includes built-in deduplication, compression, and encryption.
products.roi_pitch: Converts storage spend from CAPEX to OPEX with an average 40% savings versus traditional procurement, with immediate scalability and zero over-provisioning.
products.pain_solved: Eliminates storage over-provisioning and hardware refresh cycles every 3-5 years, delivering elastic capacity aligned to actual business growth.
